Usage:
  /usr/src/kryptokrona/miner [OPTION...]

 Core options:
      --help                                       Display this help message
      --version                                    Output software version information

 Daemon options:
      --daemon-address <host:port>                 The daemon [host:port] combination to use for node operations. This
                                                   option overrides --daemon-host and --daemon-rpc-port
      --daemon-host <host>                         The daemon host to use for node operations (default: 127.0.0.1)
      --daemon-rpc-port #                          The daemon RPC port to use for node operations (default: 11899)
      --scan-time #                                Blockchain polling interval (seconds). How often miner will check the
                                                   Blockchain for updates (default: 1)

 Mining options:
      --address <address>                          The valid CryptoNote miner's address
      --block-timestamp-interval #                 Timestamp incremental step for each subsequent block. May be set only
                                                   if --first-block-timestamp has been set. (default: 0)
      --first-block-timestamp #                    Set timestamp to the first mined block. 0 means leave timestamp
                                                   unchanged (default: 0)
      --limit #                                    Mine this exact quantity of blocks and then stop. 0 means no limit
                                                   (default: 0)
      --threads #                                  The mining threads count. Must not exceed hardware capabilities.
                                                   (default: 16)
